title: Extraterrestrial being interviewed behind a two-way mirror at S4

tellings.quote: so they went to Area 51 they got taken to S4 uh went down a number of flights down at S4 and they came to this area where there was this a a big room with a two-way mirror in it and there was an extraterrestrial being there

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, relays what a man named Albert Stein told him: that people were taken to Area 51, a secret US test site in Nevada, and then to S4, a site linked to it, where they went several floors down to a big room with a two-way mirror and an extraterrestrial being on the other side. Sheehan places this around the 1950s and 1960s and ties it to card files of the interviews held there. If true, it would mean the US government held and questioned a living being from elsewhere.
